g.text: FR-18 — The support agent's tools (one tool call)
the model requests one tool call
(SupportTools bound to the attendee from the request)
the same "not held by you" answer
for a foreign id and a missing one
the result is returned to the model
Every guarantee is code, not prompt.
The attendee is bound from the HTTP request;
the refund limit is checked inside requestRefund
on a quote the tool fetched itself.
